statement: Tight supply of memory, CPUs and IC substrate is named as the primary brake on server shipment growth and is expected to keep restraining it through 3Q26.
why: Long-lead components gate how many servers can actually be built regardless of order book, so persistent tightness caps shipments even when demand is present.

impact.mechanism: Constrained memory, CPU and substrate supply limits server assembly throughput, so accelerator-bearing systems ship later than orders would otherwise allow.

evidence.excerpt: report identifies 'tight supply of key components such as memory, CPU, and IC substrate' as the primary impediment to growth momentum, expected to continue restraining shipment acceleration through 3Q26.

confidence.basis: Single secondary research house behind a paywall; the constraint is described qualitatively with no lead-time figures given.
